about_text:
At DuoCafe, we prepare espresso from 100% specialty-grade Sublime Arabica
specially roasted for professional cafés.
The medium roast brings out a balanced flavor with notes of cocoa, hazelnuts, and dried apricots.
The beans come from carefully selected plantations in Indonesia, Colombia, and Brazil, where their unique flavor profile is formed.
We prepare every cup with a focus on precise extraction, so its full aroma and rich flavor can shine through.
about_hero_subtitle: The art of the perfect cup starts here
about_intro_p1: At DuoCafe & Bistro, we have created a place where quality gastronomy meets a welcoming atmosphere. We believe every visit should be an experience – whether you drop by for a morning coffee, a business lunch, or an evening with friends.
about_intro_p2: Every day, we prepare everything with a focus on freshness, quality ingredients, and genuine care. We apply the same dedication to selecting our coffee, which is an integral part of our concept.
about_intro_p3: Our goal is not just to cook well or brew great coffee. We want to create a place you’ll love returning to – thanks to friendly service, a cozy ambiance, and flavors you can always rely on.
about_intro_closing: We look forward to your visit.
about_brazil_text: The rich, chocolatey profiles of classic Brazilian coffee are beloved worldwide. We specifically select traditional Brazilian coffee varieties for their exceptional character. However, rather than sourcing from South America, we carefully cultivate these heritage trees on our dedicated plantations in Sumatra. This allows us to preserve the iconic Brazilian taste while enriching it with the unique terroir of the Indonesian highlands.
about_columbia_text: Renowned for their vibrant aroma and subtle fruity sweetness, Colombian coffee varieties represent some of the finest genetics in the coffee world. We brought these exceptional seedlings to the heart of Indonesia. Planted in our Sumatran soil, they retain their signature brightness while developing a deeper, more complex body that can only be achieved in this unique microclimate.
about_sumatra_text: Sumatra is the true heart of DuoCafe. Every single coffee bean we roast is grown right here, nurtured in the lush, volcanic earth of the Indonesian mountains. By taking world-class varieties from Brazil and Colombia and cultivating them in Sumatran soil, we create a truly unique cup. The tropical climate and high altitudes impart a deep, earthy elegance to the beans, resulting in a perfect harmony of global coffee heritage and passionate Indonesian craftsmanship.
